result.summary: Low-poly spacecraft: beveled fuselage (56 v), two swept wings (8 v each, roots flush with the hull), 12x6-segment cockpit (62 v). HullWhite and CockpitGlass node materials, camera and sun key light. Exported GLB + OBJ + .blend; GLB and OBJ re-imported into Blender and independently re-parsed. Two defects found by inspecting step 1 and corrected in step 2: cockpit was 482 verts (not low-poly) and the wing roots had a 5.4 cm gap to the hull.
